title: 第九章云萝公主第十章孝子第十一章促织
lines: 第九章云萝公主
卢龙县有个书生，姓安，名大业。此人生来奇异——落地便能说话，把接生的稳婆吓得差点把孩子摔了。母亲喂了他一口犬血，他才闭了嘴，像个正常婴儿一样啼哭起来。
安大业长到十五六岁，已是丰神俊秀，顾影无俦。他聪明好学，博览群书，方圆百里的世家都想把女儿嫁给他。但他母亲做了一个梦，梦里有人对她说：“你的儿子当尚主。”意思是，他该娶的是公主。
母亲信了。安大业也信了。但等了几年，公主始终没来。
安大业渐渐把这当成了一个笑话。他照常读书，照常下棋，照常过日子。他最喜欢下棋，棋艺精绝，方圆百里无人能敌。他把棋盘摆在书房里，每天对着棋局琢磨，一坐就是一整天。
这一年春天，安大业独自在书房打谱。忽然，一阵异香飘来，不是花香，不是木香，是一种他从没闻过的、清冽如泉水的香。他抬起头，一个美婢推门而入，穿着宫装，梳着高髻，面如冠玉。
“公主将至。”美婢说完，转身出去。安大业听见门外有动静——有人在铺地毯，从大门外一直铺到他的书房前。
他还没反应过来，一个女子已经扶着那美婢的肩膀走了进来。
安大业后来回忆起这一刻，总觉得眼前的一切都不真实。那女子穿着云锦衣裳，容光照人，整个屋子都亮了几分。美婢在榻上铺了绣垫，扶她坐下。安大业站在那里，手足无措，不知该说什么。
女子微笑，以袖掩口，也不说话。
美婢道：“此乃圣后府中云萝公主。圣后属意郎君，欲将公主下嫁，故使自来相宅。”
安大业惊喜交加，脑子一片空白，只会站在那里发愣。公主低下头，也不说话。两个人一个站着一个坐着，沉默了好一阵。
美婢瞥见桌上的棋盘，笑道：“公主素爱下棋，不知与驸马孰胜？”
安大业这才回过神来，忙把棋盘挪到近前。公主微微一笑，拈起一枚棋子，落在棋盘上。
两人下了不到三十手，美婢忽然把棋子搅乱了，笑道：“驸马输了！”她收好棋子，又说：“驸马应是俗间高手，公主只能让六子。”说着取出六枚黑子放在棋盘上。
安大业看着那六枚黑子，又看了看公主。公主低着头，嘴角含笑，不说话。他忽然觉得，这个女子不像是来下棋的，倒像是——专门来等他的。
【天书一笔】
天书上，云萝公主那一页，写着她的来历。她是天界公主，因犯了天条，被罚下凡历劫。她在天界时，曾路过一个书生的窗前，看见他在灯下打谱。她看了很久，记住了他的眉眼。这一眼，就是她的劫。
天书不会说“缘分”，只说“因果”。她种下了因，就要来收这个果。
公主没有在安家过夜。临行前，她让婢女取来一包金子，放在榻上，对安大业说：“此宅湫隘鄙陋，烦以此少致修饰。落成相会。”
安大业舍不得她走，起身关门，想留住她。婢女取出一物，状如皮囊，就地鼓之，一团云气从囊中涌出，顷刻间弥漫全屋，对面不见人影。待云气散尽，公主和婢女已经不见了。
安大业站在空荡荡的书房里，觉得刚才的一切像一场梦。但桌上的金子是真的，空气中的异香还在。
母亲知道了这件事，疑心是妖。但安大业神魂驰荡，日夜思念，哪里听得进去？他迫不及待地要修葺房屋，母亲劝他择吉日动工，他不听，催促工匠日夜赶工，恨不得第二天就把房子盖好。
他等了很久。房子修好了，公主没来。他又等，还是没来。
他不知道，天上一天，地上一年。公主说的“落成相会”，在他这里是数月，在她那里不过数日。他等得心焦，她却并不知道他在等。
在等待的日子里，安大业结识了一个朋友。
那人姓袁，名大用，二十出头，容貌俊雅，穿着宫绢单衣，系着丝带，脚蹬乌履，意态闲雅，风度翩翩。他主动来拜访安大业，安大业起初托故不见，后来在路上偶遇，说了几句话，觉得此人温文尔雅，很合脾气，便邀他回家下棋。
袁大用的棋艺不在安大业之下，两人互有胜负。下完棋，安大业置酒款待，谈笑甚欢。袁大业请安大业去他的寓所，珍馐美味，招待殷勤。他身边有一个小童，十二三岁，拍板清歌，还能翻筋斗作戏。安大业喝醉了走不动，袁大用让小童背他回去。安大业见那小童纤弱，怕背不动，袁大用笑道：“不妨。”小童背起安大业，健步如飞，轻轻松松送回了家。
安大业越发觉得这袁大用不是寻常人物。两人过从甚密，三五日便见一面。袁大用为人沉默寡言，但慷慨好施。街市上有人卖儿卖女，他解囊相助，替人赎回，眉头都不皱一下。安大业因此更加敬重他。
过了些日子，袁大用来向安大业辞行，临别赠他象牙筷子、楠木珠子等十余件珍玩，又送白银五百两，助他修屋。安大业推辞不过，收了珍玩，退了银子，回赠了布帛。
袁大用走后不到一个月，乐亭县出了大事。一个做官的衣锦还乡，带了大量金银财物，夜里被盗贼闯入家中，用烧红的铁钳烙灼主人，逼问财宝藏处，将财物劫掠一空。
那家人的仆人辨认出了袁大用的画像，官府行文追捕。而安大业家隔壁的邻居屠氏，素来与安家不睦，见安家大兴土木，本就心存疑忌。恰好安家一个小仆偷了袁大用所赠的象牙筷子，拿到街市上卖，被屠家看见了，认出那是袁大用的东西，便报了官。
县令派兵围了安家。安大业和仆人正好外出，不在家中，官兵便把安大业的母亲抓走了。老太太年迈体衰，受了惊吓，又连惊带怕，两天水米不进，县令怕闹出人命，把她放了。

Chapter 9 Princess Yunluo
There was a scholar in Lulong County, whose surname was An and whose name was Daye. This man was born with a strange birth - he could speak as soon as he landed, which frightened the midwife Wen so much that she almost dropped the baby. After his mother fed him a mouthful of dog blood, he shut up and cried like a normal baby.
When An Daye grew up to fifteen or sixteen years old, he was already a rich and handsome man with no family. He was smart, studious, and well-read, and families all over the country wanted to marry their daughters to him. But his mother had a dream in which someone said to her: "Your son should be the master." This meant that the one he should marry was the princess.
Mother believed it. An Daye also believed it. But after waiting for several years, the princess never came.
An Daye gradually regarded this as a joke. He studies as usual, plays chess as usual, and lives his life as usual. He likes to play chess the most. His chess skills are so good that no one can beat him within a hundred miles. He placed the chessboard in his study and pondered over it every day, sitting there all day long.
In the spring of this year, An Daye was writing music alone in his study. Suddenly, a strange fragrance wafted over, not the fragrance of flowers or wood, but a fragrance that he had never smelled before, as clear as spring water. He raised his head, and a beautiful maid pushed open the door and walked in. She was dressed in palace clothes, with a high bun, and a face like a crown jewel.
"The princess is coming." After the maid finished speaking, she turned around and left. An Daye heard movement outside the door - someone was laying a carpet from outside the door to the front of his study.
Before he could react, a woman had already walked in holding the beautiful maid's shoulders.
An Daye later recalled this moment and always felt that everything in front of him was unreal. The woman was wearing brocade clothes and her face was so radiant that the whole room lit up a bit. The beautiful maid spread an embroidered cushion on the couch and helped her sit down. An Daye stood there, at a loss, not knowing what to say.
The woman smiled, covered her mouth with her sleeves, and said nothing.
The beautiful maid said: "This is Princess Yunluo of the Holy Queen's Mansion. The Holy Queen is interested in her husband and wants to marry the princess, so she sent her to live with her."
An Daye was so surprised that his mind went blank and he would just stand there in a daze. The princess lowered her head and said nothing. The two of them stood and sat in silence for a long time.
The beautiful maid caught a glimpse of the chessboard on the table and said with a smile: "Princess loves to play chess, but I don't know who will win with the prince consort?"
An Daye finally came to his senses and quickly moved the chessboard closer. The princess smiled slightly, picked up a chess piece, and placed it on the chessboard.
The two of them had played less than thirty moves when the beautiful maid suddenly messed up the chess pieces and said with a smile: "The prince consort lost!" She put away the chess pieces and added: "The prince consort should be a worldly master, the princess can only give up six pieces." After that, she took out six black stones and put them on the chessboard.
An Daye looked at the six sunspots and then at the princess. The princess lowered her head, smiled, and said nothing. He suddenly felt that this woman didn't look like she was here to play chess, but rather like she was here to wait for him.
【One Stroke of Heavenly Book】
In the heavenly book, Princess Yunluo's page contains her origin. She is a princess from the heaven. She was punished for violating the rules of heaven and was sent to earth to endure calamity. When she was in heaven, she once passed by a scholar's window and saw him typing music under the lamp. She looked at him for a long time and memorized his facial features. This glance was her doom.
The Book of Heaven does not talk about "fate", it only talks about "cause and effect". She has planted the cause and will reap the fruit.
The princess did not stay the night at Anjia. Before leaving, she asked her maid to fetch a bag of gold, put it on the couch, and said to An Daye: "This house is narrow and humble, so I don't want to decorate it as much as possible. See you when it's completed."
An Daye was reluctant to let her go, so he stood up and closed the door, wanting to keep her. The maid took out an object that looked like a skin bag and drummed it on the spot. A cloud of air poured out of the bag and filled the whole room in an instant. No one was seen on the other side. When the clouds cleared, the princess and the maidservant were gone.
An Daye stood in the empty study room, feeling that everything just happened was like a dream. But the gold on the table is real, and the smell in the air is still there.
When my mother found out about this, she suspected it was a demon. But An Daye's soul is wandering, and he misses her day and night. How can he listen to it? He couldn't wait to repair the house. His mother advised him to choose an auspicious day to start the work, but he refused to listen and urged the craftsmen to work day and night, hoping to finish the house the next day.
He waited a long time. The house was repaired, but the princess did not come. He waited again, but still didn't come.
He doesn’t know that one day in heaven and one year on earth. The "final meeting" that the princess mentioned was months for him, but only a few days for her. He waited anxiously, but she didn't know that he was waiting.
While waiting, An Daye made a friend.
The man's surname was Yuan, and his given name was Dayong. He was in his early twenties, with handsome appearance. He was wearing a single coat of palace silk, tied with a ribbon, and wore black shoes. He had an elegant attitude and a graceful demeanor. He took the initiative to visit An Daye, who excused himself from seeing An Daye at first. Later, he met An Daye by chance on the road and said a few words. He felt that the man was gentle and well-tempered, so he invited him home to play chess.
Yuan Dayong's chess skills are not inferior to An Daye's, and the two of them win or lose each other. After playing chess, An Daye entertained them with wine and had a great time talking and laughing. Yuan Daye invited An Daye to his apartment, where he was treated to delicious food and hospitality. There was a child beside him, twelve or thirteen years old, who could sing songs and do somersaults. An Daye was too drunk to walk, so Yuan Dayong asked a boy to carry him back. An Daye saw that the little boy was frail and afraid that he would not be able to carry it, so Yuan Dayong smiled and said, "It doesn't matter." The boy picked up An Daye, walked as fast as flying, and sent him home easily.
An Daye felt more and more that Yuan Dayong was no ordinary person. The two of them were very close and would see each other every three to five days. Yuan Dayong was a man of few words, but generous and charitable. Someone was selling his son or daughter in the market, and he helped out with his own money and redeemed them without even frowning. An Daye respected him even more.
Some days later, Yuan Da used to say goodbye to An Daye, and gave him more than ten treasures such as ivory chopsticks and nanmu beads. He also gave him 500 taels of silver to help him repair his house. An Daye couldn't refuse, so he took away the treasures, refunded the money, and gave cloths in return.
Less than a month after Yuan Dayong left, something big happened in Leting County. An official returned home in fine clothes, bringing with him a large amount of gold and silver. Thieves broke into his home at night, burned the owner with red-hot iron tongs, forced him to find the whereabouts of the treasure, and robbed him of all the property.
The servant of that family recognized Yuan Dayong's portrait, and the government issued a lawsuit to pursue him. The Tu family, the neighbor next door to An Daye's family, has always been at odds with the An family. Seeing the An family's large-scale construction work, they were suspicious. It happened that a servant of the An family stole the ivory chopsticks donated by Yuan Dayong and sold them in the market. The butcher saw it and recognized it as Yuan Dayong's, so he reported it to the official.
The county magistrate sent troops to surround Anjia. An Daye and his servant happened to be out and were not at home, so the officers and soldiers took An Daye's mother away. The old lady was old and frail. She was frightened and frightened. She had no food or water for two days. The county magistrate let her go for fear of causing harm to others.
title_en: Chapter 9: Princess Yunluo Chapter 10: Dutiful Son Chapter 11: Promoting Weaving
